patches.why: R2's buckets are in the region auto, which AWS's enum of location constraints does not have: "When using the S3 API, the region for an R2 bucket is auto. ... This also applies to the LocationConstraint for the CreateBucket API." (https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/api/s3/api/)

source.quote: When using the S3 API, the region for an R2 bucket is auto.

patches.why: The model's uri for AbortMultipartUpload carries the query literal `x-id=AbortMultipartUpload`; S3's AbortMultipartUpload reference page gives the request line as `DELETE /Key+?uploadId=UploadId HTTP/1.1`, with no x-id. The literal is dropped so the operation's discriminator does not require what S3's request does not carry.
